name: tokimeter-ts
description: FinOps for AI agents — proxy, VS Code extension, and shared core

scripts.build: node --check packages/proxy/src/server.js && node --check packages/proxy/src/cli.js && node --check packages/proxy/src/parsers.js && node --check packages/proxy/src/cloud-sync.js && node --check packages/vscode-extension/src/extension.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "import('./packages/core/src/index.js')" && node --test test/parsers.test.js test/pace.test.js test/cloud-sync.test.js test/cloud-connect.test.js
scripts.dev:vscode: echo 'Open ts/packages/vscode-extension in VS Code and press F5'
scripts.release:check: npm run privacy:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:core:dry && npm run pack:proxy:dry
